{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the sentinel value is -999.0 and check how many instances
sentinel_value = -999.0
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Report the count
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if any other sentinel values exist (e.g., 0, -1, etc.)
print("\nOther potential sentinel values:")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([0, -1, -2, -1000, -999.1]).sum())"}
